column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Combined from the community Arabic catalogs in #2505, #4520, #4569, #5593, #5915, #6092 and
# #6287: each row takes the best of their translations, with one term per concept across the UI.
# Modern Standard Arabic; menu commands use verbal nouns (فتح، حفظ باسم…). Product and technology
# names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, GPU, CMYK, OpenType …) and key names stay in Latin letters; the
# trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept. Clean-room: written from the plain meaning of the English
# labels; no proprietary localisation resource was consulted. Plural rule (CLDR):
# zero|one|two|few|many|other. Reviewed for consistency by an AI model; native-speaker review of
# Layer Mask Display Options (the layer mask rubylith's colour and opacity)
# Channel Options and New Spot Channel (#3761)

column2: Set GPU Memory in Preferences › Performance to what your graphics card can hold, at most 3/8 of its memory. Automatic follows Memory Usage, within a quarter of this computer's memory and 3/8 of the card's, and doesn't count the document against a card whose memory is known. The status bar shows GPU Memory Full while they don't fit.
